notes.title: CrimeBloc Launches on Steam — New Round + Major Code Overhaul Underway!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615630/c4157c4568c235eb28c65eb563bcf823afe2a8b2.png"][/img][/p][h1]🚀 Welcome, Steam Players! New Round Now Live + Patch Notes + Free Promo Code[/h1][p]For the first time ever… [b]CrimeBloc is on Steam![/b]
If you are new here — welcome to the chaos. If you are returning — you already know exactly what kind of trouble you are about to get into.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]What is CrimeBloc?[/h2][p]CrimeBloc is an [b]18-year-old text-based mafia game[/b]. Yes — you read that right. We have been running this thing for nearly two decades.[/p][p]Over that time, the game has grown in depth (and a little bit of character… and dust).
Some features were designed in a different internet era entirely — but that is also part of the charm.[/p][p]Now that we are live on Steam, we are not just sitting back. We are taking this opportunity to [b]overhaul the entire game’s code[/b].
This is not just a facelift — we are rebuilding the core of CrimeBloc to make it faster, more stable, and 100x better for players.[/p][p]And yes — that also means [b]deeper Steam integration[/b] coming soon:[/p][list][*][p]Better achievement handling[/p][/*][*][p]Richer presence and status[/p][/*][*][p]Improved UI/UX across desktop, mobile and Steam[/p][/*][/list][p]The current round is the beginning — the future of CrimeBloc is already in progress.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615630/9eb09f5ab606ce5447bf0839ca7910772b223364.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Fixing the Old Bones[/h2][p]Before diving into this round’s new features — a quick note:
When a game has run for 18 years, there is bound to be a few bugs lurking in dark corners.
We have spent the first half of 2025 cleaning house:[/p][p]✅ [b]83 Enhancements[/b]
✅ [b]109 Changes[/b]
✅ [b]67 Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]That is [b]259 updates[/b] rolled out so far this year.
Some fixed bugs players had simply learned to live with. Some polished the game ready for its Steam debut.
The result: CrimeBloc is in the best shape it has been in years — with a complete code overhaul underway to take it even further.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]This Round: What’s New?[/h2][p][b]The big one:[/b] PVE has been removed.
We are moving to a unified system and adding a [b]reputation mechanic[/b] to Murder in the coming weeks. The streets will be dangerous — but every action will have consequences.[/p][p]Other key changes:[/p][p]• Hitman now usable once per week (and it costs more)
• Credits to Bullet conversion price increased
• Offline Progression added to Auto Theft & Crimes (disabled first week)
• [b]St Petersburg[/b] added as a new city
• Linked Account System — no more re-signing up after death
• Organised Crime timers reduced to 12 hours
• OC payouts lowered
• Leveling is slower to improve pacing
• New Weekly OC (10 players) — launches every Friday
• Upvote & Downvote added to posts/comments
• Extort button added to profiles
• Lottery now shows 3 winners + updated payouts
• 10% of money from weekly player kills boosts Lottery jackpot
• Bullet stats now on Game Stats page
• Leaderboards reactivated & improved
• Buffed bullets payouts from Operations
• Lowered Life Insurance EXP return[/p][hr][/hr][h2]What We Are Building Next[/h2][p]The dev team is now heavily focused on [b]rebuilding CrimeBloc’s codebase[/b] — bringing in new systems that will:[/p][p]✅ Modernise the game for [b]2025+[/b]
✅ Allow [b]better Steam integration[/b]
✅ Smooth out performance on desktop, mobile and browser
✅ Future-proof the game for years to come[/p][p]You will see parts of this rolling out steadily in the coming months.
We will also be opening a [b]NextGen test server[/b] soon where players can preview and give feedback on the new systems.[/p][p]Upcoming features include:[/p][p]• Voting Websites in Daily Challenges
• Referral system
• More Criminal Job Achievements
• Credit Reward Programs
• Extortion Protection
• Casino Marketplace
• Weekly In-Game Cash Donation Drive
• Real-time Autotheft Shipping Timers
• Extortion of All Cars (unless garaged)
• Linked Bank Vault (no password required)
• UI showing Boss Fight Protection progress
• Account Activation Reminders[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🎁 Free Promo Code (For Steam Players + Everyone Else)[/h2][p]To celebrate the new round + Steam launch:[/p][p]Go to [b]My Account[/b] → [b]Promo Codes[/b]
Enter code: [b]STEAM63[/b][/p][p]Claim your free reward and get started.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615630/45e56ebe388614a456acac38ec2e3b8e3c0b8e3d.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Final Word[/h2][p]CrimeBloc is a game built by players, for players.
Some of you will be here to cause trouble. Some will be here to build an empire. Some will just try to stay alive.[/p][p]However you play — welcome to the Bloc.
You are joining a game with [b]18 years of history[/b] and a future that is being written right now.[/p][p][b]See you on the streets.[/b][/p][p]Play here: [/p][p][url="https://www.crimebloc.com"]www.crimebloc.com[/url][/p][p]
Or on Steam: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2930110/CrimeBloc/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
